reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must accept a level-66 entry written `66 data-name-1 RENAMES data-name-2 [ {THROUGH|THRU} data-name-3 ] .` (data-name-1 required, THROUGH and THRU equivalent, data-name-2/3 qualifiable) and refuse any other shape of the renames entry.

reader.notes: The one grammar rule renamesClause is the 1985 format exactly (one data-name-2, an optional THROUGH|THRU data-name-3), reached only as the whole body of a data description entry, so no other clause can join it; LevelNumberPass pins the 66 level and the required data-name-1. Nothing on the path branches on the edition, and the 1985 format is the same as the later editions'. Side observation (not this rule): an unqualified data-name-2 that also names an item of ANOTHER record is refused as ambiguous (COBOL1639 citing §1985:IV.4.3.8.1 SR3), which matches the 1985 uniqueness-of-reference rule and SR5 (`may be qualified`).

refuter.evidence: Probes under E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-229/src, run with run_probe.py --std 85. rf1b.cob: data-name-2 AND data-name-3 both qualified (A OF REC THROUGH C IN G IN REC; B OF G OF REC THRU D OF REC; RENAMES C OF REC; a same-named R1 in a second record qualified by its 01) prints Q1 [ABCD12] Q2 [CD12EFG] Q3 [13] Q4 [ZZYY34] (the reader qualified only data-name-2). rf1.cob (my under-qualified first try) refused 'B OF G' and 'C' COBOL1639 because G and C exist in two records: correct, SR5 permits qualification and uniqueness demands it. Refusals: rf2 RENAMES A THRU B THROUGH T -> COBOL0300; '66 S3 IS RENAMES A' -> COBOL5506; 'RENAMES IS A' -> COBOL5506; missing separator period -> COBOL0307; rf3 'RENAMES T(1)' (subscripted, not a data-name) -> COBOL2024; rf4 a VALUE after RENAMES -> COBOL0001; rf6 '66 S7 PIC X.' -> COBOL1747. rf5 'A THRU A' and 'B THRU A' -> COBOL2740 (SR4/SR8 neighbours). No later-edition RENAMES form exists to refuse: the 1985 shape is the only shape. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.5.11.2 (the text is in the clause); OK §1985:VI.5.11.3 SR5. The grep of LevelNumberPass/DataBinder.RenamesEntry for CobolVersion|ConstructRegistry|IsAtLeast|DialectBehavior found nothing, which agrees with the reader's empty edition-consulted list. Side note: the refusals cite §2023 clauses at --std 85, which affects only the diagnostic text.
